messages:
Rina Shah: Hi team! Rina here — joining product infra today. Quick intro: previously ran SRE at a marketplace startup. Couple of first-day questions: 1) How do I get access to the feature-flag console? 2) I can't see some private channels after signup. Fun fact: I run a small urban beekeeping co-op on weekends. 🐝

Kai Morales: Welcome Rina :tada: — were excited to have you. For flags, file a request at infra-requests and ping me for expediting. PM me if you want a repo walkthrough. Which time zone are you in?

Rina Shah: Pacific (PST). Will open the infra-requests ticket now. Also I got a 403 when trying to open #eng-product-reviews.

Jordan (IT): Hey Rina — I see your SSO provisioning completed but channel membership sync can lag ~10-15m. Try /refresh in Slack and let me know the exact 403 screen. If you see an "access_denied" notice, post a screenshot or copy the message.

Lena (People Ops): Welcome! Badge and laptop are at reception — they asked to confirm arrival time. I sent a welcome kit email; check the personal address on file. Lunch with your buddy is scheduled Friday at noon.

Rina Shah: Opening ticket: https://infra.redwood.com/requests/flag-access-1835 — added details. Attached the 403 text: "You do not have permission to view this channel (403)". /refresh didn't help.

Jordan (IT): Thanks — I manually added you to the channel group and re-synced. Try now. Also for future quick refresh from terminal you can run:

```
sudo scutil --set HostName redwood-dev
```

(not required for Slack but helpful for some internal tooling).

ops-bot: task-9812: infra-requests flag access created for user rina.shah. ETA: manual review in 30m.

Rina Shah: Channel access looks good now, I can see #eng-product-reviews. Thanks Jordan!

Kai Morales: Nice! Quick note — our team standup is 9:15 PT, and we do async updates in the thread pinned to #eng-runtime. Also we have a short intro around 11:00 to meet the rest of product infra.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: Complete security training by 2026-03-30. New hire checklist: https://onboard.redwood.com/rina.shah

Rina Shah: All set, thanks everyone. Happy to bring honey cookies to Friday lunch if anyones into beekeeper treats :)
